answer: Each identity must lock a 500 POA bond for 90 days before earning, slashed in full on proven fraud. A farm running 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 POA for three months while honest agents risk one bond each. Like timber seasoning slowly, trust accrues only with time; a prism audit splits every bond across three independent reviewers, so one bad review cannot free a fake; and the lantern is public, every slash is published, so the farm's losses are visible before it scales.
